name: Sentry Droid X-5
description: The Sentry Droid X-5 was a model of sentry droid produced by the Okara Droid Company at the Okara Droid Factory on the planet Balmorra. Armed with blaster rifles, a number of them were used to defend the assembly line of the factory during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.
